style: tactile monochrome ink-and-cut-paper editorial collage on archival stock with charcoal linework, halftone grain, and restrained vermilion accents

assets.description: A missing paper deliverable falls through an audit ledger while an approval stamp still lands beside its outline.
An empty multi-section phase folder passes an open mechanical validation gate.
Five paper paths representing working-tree states converge on an audit table while deletion remains a negative-space slot.

notes: Original raster artwork was generated as a coherent editorial contact sheet, visually inspected, cropped into three single-focal 16:9 compositions, resized, stripped, and WebP-compressed. No readable text, logos, fake UI, proprietary trade dress, or watermarks are present.
